description: This image helps the reader understand that among all ways of weighting fair coins, two equal coins make the sum overshoot one standard deviation the most: the average overshoot is 0.207 for two equal coins, against 0.183 for three and 0.167 for the Gaussian.
head: Two equal coins are the worst case
sub: Average overshoot beyond one standard deviation is at most (√2 − 1)/2
